## Summary

Describe the problem and approach. Link any related issue.

## Verification

List commands run and results. Include screenshots for UI changes.

- [ ] Added or updated tests for changed behavior (or explained why not needed).
- [ ] Updated affected documentation and examples.
- [ ] Ran formatting, type checks, tests, builds, and applicable package smoke checks from CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Included the regenerated Action bundle if its source or bundled dependencies changed.
- [ ] Removed secrets, private source maps, and real user telemetry from fixtures and attachments.
